title: Analog input
description: Calibration of the analog input: value = volts * multiplier + offset.

keys.name: multiplier
keys.title: Multiplier
keys.description: Scale from the measured volts to the unit of the published path. With the default the device publishes volts.

keys.name: period_ms
keys.title: Sample period
keys.description: Time between readings. Each reading averages 16 samples.
